name: Newhaven, Village Entrance
desc1: Welcome to Newhaven! You are standing at the crude wooden gates of the
desc2: village entrance, in the middle of a dusty path. A low wooden palisade
desc3: surrounds the village, to protect against creatures of the night and
desc4: random raiders. You can see small buildings to the north and south,
desc5: and a dusty path that leads to the west and southeast.
